explication: Crest is a cross-platform browser centered on isolated Spaces, with Chromium and WebKit page engines and shared browser state. The main workflow is to choose a Space, open or route a page, host it on an engine, and retain its state; the README also documents sync, page tools, privacy, customization, and import/export. Several capability branches are represented at their documented subsystem level because their implementation was not sampled.
